description: Domain-neutral motor decision as one graph-native collapse: state-scoped learned/default order-0 proposal; proposal-versus-grounded residual as the sole authorization for deeper valuation; stable ordinal collapse; and grounded settle-back into each option's fast value. Options are the Union of a decision state's in_scene and in_episode neighbours. A domain-neutral episode bridge provisions one bounded state, fully scopes, publishes once, and safely rearms it for any has_embodied_motor_episode. Contains no body, actuator-meaning, or physics model.

microtheory.name: motor_decision_collapse
microtheory.description: Fast defaults become learned habits; residual keeps the same collapse open for grounded valuation until it can settle.

rules.name: mdc_fast_propose
rules.comment: Order-0 proposal from the state-local option set. An experienced option uses its learned value; a novel option falls back to its graph-held default. Stable ordinal resolves exact ties.

rules.name: mdc_shallow_settle
rules.comment: A small residual means the fast/default proposal is already settled. Disabling depth also caps the same collapse at order zero.

rules.name: mdc_residual_authorized_deepen
rules.comment: There is no separate escalation policy: only a residual above tolerance authorizes grounded order-N valuation. The same stable ordinal total-orders ties.

rules.name: mdc_internalize_scene_option
rules.comment: Settle the grounded valuation back into each scene-scoped option's fast learned value. An epoch stamp makes the Union idempotent when an option is linked through both scopes.

rules.name: mdc_internalize_episode_option
rules.comment: Settle the grounded valuation back into each episode-scoped option's fast learned value. An epoch stamp makes the Union idempotent when an option is linked through both scopes.

rules.name: mdc_finish_internalization
rules.comment: The decision becomes externally readable only after the fast proposal and grounded winner have settled back into the fast substrate. Unchosen non-competitors receive no fictitious action credit.

rules.name: mdc_episode_provision_state
rules.comment: Provision one reusable graph decision slot while an episode exposes options, before any request arms it. AddNodeIfAbsent keys the slot by episode identity; the same rule scopes every exposed option. A later request opens this dormant slot, avoiding host lifecycle code.

rules.name: mdc_episode_open_state
rules.comment: A graph-authored, monotonically newer episode request opens the episode's one provisioned state using domain-neutral policy values. The scope-count equality forbids opening on a partial option set.

rules.name: mdc_episode_unscope_removed_option
rules.comment: Between decisions, remove an option no longer exposed by the episode. Provisioning adds new options; this complement keeps the one reusable state's scope bounded and exact.

rules.name: mdc_episode_refuse_empty
rules.comment: An armed epoch with no exposed options refuses explicitly instead of fabricating a token or leaving an unbounded active state.

rules.name: mdc_episode_disarm_stale_request
rules.comment: A duplicate or older epoch cannot reopen or republish a decision. Once no state is active, consume the stale armed flag while leaving the last published opaque verdict intact.

rules.name: mdc_episode_publish_once
rules.comment: Publish exactly once and only from a settled state whose required settle-back is complete. Copy the opaque verdict and audit trace to the episode, disarm it, and make the transient inactive.
